title: xDrip deleted my database
symptom: xDrip deleted the user's database multiple times, despite backup and delete older settings being unmarked. The user reinstalled and the problem recurred. They have data in Nightscout and tried to download it back but no success.
evidence_quote: I reinstalled everything and tonight the database has been erased. This is something never happened before, I've been using xdrip+ for years. This is the first time I use it with Libre 2 (before always Dexcom), don't know if this has any relation.
